name: PMS1 homolog 1, mismatch repair system component

function.text: PMS1 encodes PMS1 protein homolog 1. Annotated molecular activities include ATP hydrolysis activity and ATP-dependent DNA damage sensor activity. It participates in mismatch repair and response to xenobiotic stimulus.

germline.text: No established constitutional disease association is assigned after the condition-specific evidence review; disputed or limited relationships are withheld rather than treated as positive findings.
